question: Can the already exact R144 eight-register-buffer arithmetic meet the M128 latency gate solely by using the legal 16x16-per-subgroup, wg8x4 geometry, whose 128x64 workgroup output tile halves the M workgroup count versus wg4x4?

evidence_base.omission: R144 screened wg4x2 and wg4x4 at 16x16 per subgroup but did not screen wg8x4. The latter has 512 workitems, preserves each subgroup's registers and arithmetic, and changes only workgroup scheduling.
evidence_base.tiny_m_anchor: R144 natural controls proved natural oneDNN M1, M2, and M4 bitwise identical on both dominant shapes; therefore the frozen exact selector may retain natural oneDNN for M<=4.

sole_candidate.name: m16_n16_wg8x4
sole_candidate.geometry: 16x16 output per subgroup, wg8x4, 512 workitems, 128x64 output per workgroup
sole_candidate.arithmetic: Unchanged R144 kri64 path: eight FP32 register C buffers and ascending C0+=C1..C7 reduction.

execution.isolation: One fresh bounded container, private IPC, 1 GiB shared memory, 10 GiB memory with 14 GiB limit, 300 second timeout, core dumps disabled.
execution.source_or_build_changes: None authorized. Use the frozen R144 extension, harness, natural controls, and references.

operator_screen.identity: Every complete output must equal concatenated natural oneDNN M1 rows. M512 prefixes, M128 repeat and seeded permutation, and M168-to-M200 random-padding content must also be bitwise exact.
operator_screen.timing: Ten warmups and five samples of 100 synchronized calls at M2, M64, M128, M168, and M256 against natural oneDNN.
operator_screen.stability: No timed sample max/min ratio may exceed 1.15.

gates.candidate: Generation, complete identity, prefix/repeat/permutation/padding identity, and stability are independently required. Candidate must be <=2.0x natural on both shapes at M168 and M256.
gates.frozen_selector: Use natural oneDNN for M<=4, R144 m16_n16_wg4x2 for 8<=M<=64, and R145 m16_n16_wg8x4 for M>=128. Every region is required to be bitwise identical to concatenated natural M1 rows.
gates.decode_latency: Using frozen 16:64 attention-QKV:gate-up call counts, the selector must be <=1.03x natural at M2, M64, and M128. Natural defines 1.0x at M2; the recorded R144 wg4x2 ratio defines M64; R145 defines M128.
gates.prefill_latency: The R145 candidate must be <=2.0x natural in the frozen weighted model at M168 and M256.
gates.on_pass: Expand the three-region selector to all six production shapes and apply the <=1.03 frozen all-shape decode model before any serving build.
gates.on_failure: Close eight-live-buffer workgroup scheduling. The next permitted arithmetic implementation is serialized p0..p7 traversal with C0 plus one reusable temporary C tile, enabling a 32x32 subgroup tile. Do not add another R144 geometry arm.

abort_conditions: any current-boot Xe fault, CAT error, reset, coredump, device loss, timeout, or hung stage visible to the available health interfaces
either B70 is not normal before or after the device case
any unregistered strategy, source/build edit, server launch, collective experiment, or second-GPU use
